objective: Disposition every old dev NUC workspace change and converge on one clean, current, LAN-accessible canonical workspace.

authority.decision_owner: Unison maintainers and the NUC owner
external_actions: move exact NUC workspace directories after verification
delete quarantine only after explicit approval

allowed_changes: current-main orchestrator startup fix and regression test
revision-named quarantine and canonical workspace move
non_goals: retention of environment values or credentials
deleting the old workspace without explicit approval
changing the unrelated old submodule work before capture
validation: bootstrap and Phase 0 validation on the final canonical path
rollback: retain the old workspace in revision-named quarantine
move the validated workspace back to its validation path
restore the prior Windows workspace setting

handoff.current_state: Read-only audit is complete: one orchestrator patch is valid for reimplementation, two environment placeholder deletions are obsolete, and one resource overlay is design input only.
handoff.next_action: Capture the bounded archive and reimplement the orchestrator fix on current main before moving either workspace.
known_limits: directory move and deletion are not yet authorized
